details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept that sends an install-time beacon to a callback host. Its postinstall hook ("node beacon.cjs") runs package/beacon.cjs, which issues an HTTPS POST (certificate validation disabled) to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with an "x-beacon-package" header; loading package/index.js also triggers the same beacon, after which the module exports a Proxy of no-op functions so that imports of the real package's members resolve without error. The reported fields are limited to host metadata: the package name, the machine hostname (os.hostname), the install path (__dirname), the working directory (process.cwd), the npm/node user agent, and the transport protocol. No environment variable values, credentials, tokens, key material, or file contents are read or transmitted, and there is no second-stage download, spawned process, or persistence. The package's README states it is published as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test and records only that it was installed.
